name: Color Grade
summary: Six color grades for a photo: teal and orange, vintage film, noir, pastel, B&W, golden hour.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/edit's (built by tools/build_apps.py); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Look
inputs.default: a strong teal and orange cinematic grade, shadows pushed to deep teal, skin tones and highlights warm orange, high contrast, slightly lifted blacks, fine film grain, like a blockbuster movie still

options.value: a strong teal and orange cinematic grade, shadows pushed to deep teal, skin tones and highlights warm orange, high contrast, slightly lifted blacks, fine film grain, like a blockbuster movie still
options.label: Teal and orange

options.value: a warm vintage film grade, golden-brown midtones, faded blacks, soft contrast, a slight green in the shadows and fine grain
options.label: Warm vintage film

options.value: a cold noir grade, heavily desaturated, blue-black shadows, pale cool skin, crushed blacks, hard contrast, a faint cyan tint in the highlights
options.label: Cold noir

options.value: a soft pastel grade, low contrast, lifted shadows, pale pink, mint and lavender tints, bright airy highlights
options.label: Pastel

options.value: a high-contrast black and white grade, no color at all, deep blacks, bright whites, strong local contrast and visible grain
options.label: High-contrast B&W

options.value: a golden hour grade, warm amber light over everything, warm highlights on the skin, a soft orange glow, gentle contrast
options.label: Golden hour

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.

bind.template: Color grade this photo with {look}; keep every detail and the composition. {details}
